description: Extensive villa site, but not yet well published. Built some time in the beginning of the 2nd CE on the site of earlier Late Iron Age occupation. Reportedly the site included a structure interpreted as a temple-mausoleum. The villa lasted until its abandonment in the early 5th CE.
bibliography: Mackey, R. “The Welton Villa - a View of Social and Economic Change during the Roman Period.” In Further Light on the Parisi: Recent Research in Iron Age and Roman East Yorkshire, edited by P Halkon, 21–32, 1999.
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Welton Villa (East Riding).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
